title: A small beginning
style: Warm cinematic photography, natural light, consistent amber and blue palette. No text or watermarks.

scenes.narration: Every story begins with a small idea, waiting to be noticed.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a blank notebook and pencil on a wooden desk beside a sunlit window.

scenes.narration: Give it a little attention, and something new starts to grow.
scenes.image_prompt: A tiny green seedling growing in a terracotta pot beside the same sunlit window.

scenes.narration: You do not need the whole picture. Just take the next step.
scenes.image_prompt: A quiet garden path leading toward warm morning sunlight, hopeful and inviting.
